description: Definitive port of the NTM Space fork in a form of the addon for 1.12.2 NTM:CE.

item: You shall face the iron will of divinity
block: Allows for the construction of multi-stage orbital rockets.$Each stage can travel to another body, provided it has enough fuel,$eg. a two stage rocket can travel to the Moon and back.
An interplanetary receiver dish that can locate signals from planets$and discover safe landing zones.$Requires an empty Hard Drive to program.
Captures CO2 generated within a sealed, pressurized room.
Collects mineral-rich magma from highly-active volcanic planets and moons.
Connect Plasma Heater to inject fuel.
Connect to a PWR that has control rods and Liquid Hydrogen coolant.
Converts CO2 -> O2 via continuous crop growth$Can grow any single block crops
Converts CO2 back into O2.$Only functions in orbit.
Enables remote access to the StarDar.$Shift right click StarDar with reactor sensor to start linking.$Then shift right click the console to finish link.
Fuels and prepares a rocket constructed in the Vehicle Assembly Base for launch.
Launches swarm members into solar orbit.$Swarm members decay over time, so continuous launching is required for upkeep.
Receives energy from a swarm and fires it as a beam.$Requires a relay satellite to operate at night.
Requires a near vacuum to function
Used for constructing and launching rockets from an orbital station.
